name: Publish a scoped execution record alongside scientific review
evidence: Steps 4–6 archive how the code was run, generated outputs and auxiliary files; the paper distinguishes mechanical verification from scientific validation.

operational_primitive.transformation: Record exact check scope, environment, outputs and unresolved barriers; archive and link the record.

constraints: An execution record cannot certify scientific truth; checking needs labor and may involve author clarification.
reuse_hypothesis: A compact record could let scientific reviewers assess what an agent result actually demonstrated without interpreting a badge.
next_test: Draft one scoped record for an existing reproduction and ask a domain reviewer which conclusions it justifies; no new experiment.
word_count_convention: Whitespace-separated tokens in recursive string values; excludes word_count and this convention; excludes JSON keys.
